cutoff_policy: Select k on validation union F1: single 1..60; multi 1..20 per vector. Deduplicate union. Report actual counts and fixed-budget diagnostics at 10,20,60,100 using round-robin deduplication.
selection: Best validation union F1 among updated checkpoints for trained approaches; frozen initialization validation is reported separately. Test never used for selection.
component_metrics: Macro average per component within query, then across queries; final merged predictions against each gold component; exclude components without accepted positive labels.
